mapper.select: WITH scoped AS ( SELECT sc.id, sc.schedule_date, sc.status AS schedule_status, d.id AS doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, d.status AS doctor_status, dp.id AS department_id, dp.name AS department_name, dp.status AS department_status FROM doctor_schedule sc JOIN doctor d ON d.id = sc.doctor_id JOIN department dp ON dp.id = d.department_id WHERE sc.schedule_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND (#{departmentId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR dp.id = #{departmentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ), occupancy AS ( SELECT sc.id, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND s.start_at > #{now} AND sc.schedule_date BETWEEN #{today} AND #{patientEnd} AND sc.schedule_status = 'OPEN' AND sc.doctor_status = 'ACTIVE' AND sc.department_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS remaining, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'RESERVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS occupied FROM scoped sc LEFT JOIN appointment_slot s ON s.schedule_id = sc.id GROUP BY sc.id ), bookings AS ( SELECT sc.id, COUNT(*) AS booked, SUM(CASE WHEN a.booked_via = 'PORTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS portal, SUM(CASE WHEN a.booked_via = 'AGENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agent FROM scoped sc JOIN appointment_slot s ON s.schedule_id = sc.id JOIN appointment a ON a.slot_id = s.id AND a.status IN ('BOOKED', 'CHECKED_IN', 'VISITED') GROUP BY sc.id ) SELECT sc.schedule_date, sc.schedule_status, sc.department_id, sc.department_name, sc.doctor_id, sc.doctor_name, COALESCE(b.booked, 0) AS booked, COALESCE(b.portal, 0) AS portal, COALESCE(b.agent, 0) AS agent, o.remaining, o.occupied FROM scoped sc JOIN occupancy o ON o.id = sc.id LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.id = sc.id ORDER BY sc.department_name, sc.department_id, sc.doctor_name, sc.doctor_id, sc.schedule_date
